steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cook quinoa in 360 ml water over medium heat for 12 minutes; spread on a plate to cool.
Peel and finely grate the beet and the apple; squeeze out excess liquid with a clean cloth.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled quinoa, grated beet, and grated apple.
Add the egg, chickpea flour, cinnamon, maple syrup, and melted coconut oil.
Mix firmly until the mixture holds together when pressed between two fingers.
Scoop 20 equal portions onto the prepared baking sheet and press each into a round 2 cm thick.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the edges are set and the tops feel firm to the touch.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes before serving; bites firm up further as they cool.
Keep in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 1 month.
